definitions: A large deer species (Cervus elaphus) native to Europe, Asia, and North Africa, known for its reddish-brown coat.
The meat of this deer, used as food.
examples: The red deer grazed peacefully in the meadow.
We had red deer for dinner last night.
A majestic red deer stag stood on the hill.
synonyms: wapiti (North American, sometimes considered a subspecies)
